decisions.reason: This automation offering is closely related to the firm's existing thermal and machinery engineering knowledge, so an established German medium-sized manufacturer is likely to keep learning from early installations and improve it rather than withdraw it quickly.

A web-based weir-dimensioning tool is less central to the firm's core machinery capabilities and commercial routines, so despite possible technical usefulness it is more likely to be discontinued if it does not clearly support the main business.

A fouling detection system for heat exchangers fits strongly with the firm's accumulated domain knowledge and should benefit from its absorptive capacity in sensing customer needs, interpreting early results, and refining the product.
